definition: safe or suitable to be eaten
contextSentence: During a long day spent roaming the forest in search of edible grains and herbs.
contextSentenceKo: 먹을 수 있는 곡물과 약초를 찾아 숲을 돌아다니며 긴 하루를 보내던 중이었습니다.

definition: feeling or showing extreme tiredness, especially from excessive effort
contextSentence: The weary divine farmer Shen Nong accidentally poisoned himself 72 times.
contextSentenceKo: 지친 신농씨는 실수로 72번이나 자기 자신을 중독시켰습니다.

definition: occurring in or characteristic of myths or folk tales; imaginary or fictitious
contextSentence: The mythical Chinese inventor of agriculture, highlights tea's importance to ancient China.
contextSentenceKo: 신화 속 중국 농업의 창시자는 고대 중국에서 차의 중요성을 잘 보여줍니다.

definition: relating to the study of human history through excavation of sites and analysis of artifacts
contextSentence: Archaeological evidence suggests tea was first cultivated there as early as 6,000 years ago.
contextSentenceKo: 고고학적 증거에 따르면 차는 이미 6,000년 전에 그곳에서 처음 재배되었을 가능성이 있습니다.

definition: prepared and used land for growing crops; developed or improved through care
contextSentence: Tea was first cultivated there as early as 6,000 years ago.
contextSentenceKo: 차는 이미 6,000년 전에 그곳에서 처음 재배되었습니다.

definition: a soft food made by boiling grain or cereal in water or milk
etymology: Middle English alteration of 'pottage' meaning 'soup, stew'
contextSentence: It was eaten as a vegetable or cooked with grain porridge.
contextSentenceKo: 차는 채소로 먹거나 곡물죽에 넣어 끓여 먹었습니다.

definition: water or other liquid diffused in a small quantity; dampness
contextSentence: When people realized that a combination of heat and moisture could create a complex and varied taste.
contextSentenceKo: 사람들이 열과 수분의 조합이 복잡하고 다양한 맛을 낼 수 있다는 것을 깨달았을 때였습니다.

definition: exceeding what is reasonable or appropriate; elaborate and impressive
contextSentence: They would draw extravagant pictures in the foam of the tea.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 차의 거품 위에 화려한 그림을 그리곤 했습니다.

definition: a ceremony or series of acts regularly repeated in a set manner
contextSentence: The Japanese eventually developed their own unique rituals around tea.
contextSentenceKo: 일본은 결국 차를 중심으로 자신들만의 독특한 의식을 발전시켰습니다.

definition: the exclusive possession or control of the supply of a commodity or service
contextSentence: China still held a virtual monopoly on the world's tea trees.
contextSentenceKo: 중국은 여전히 세계 차나무에 대한 사실상의 독점권을 쥐고 있었습니다.

definition: a hard, white, translucent ceramic material used for making fine pottery
etymology: Italian 'porcellana' from 'porcella' (cowrie shell), due to its resemblance
contextSentence: Making tea one of three essential Chinese export goods, along with porcelain and silk.
contextSentenceKo: 차는 도자기, 비단과 함께 중국의 3대 필수 수출품이 되었습니다.

definition: the highest class in certain societies, typically comprising people of noble birth
contextSentence: For making tea popular with the English aristocracy when she married King Charles II in 1661.
contextSentenceKo: 1661년 찰스 2세와 결혼하면서 영국 귀족 사회에 차를 유행시킨 것으로 유명합니다.

definition: relating to or characteristic of a colony or colonialism
contextSentence: Great Britain was in the midst of expanding its colonial influence.
contextSentenceKo: 영국은 한창 식민지 영향력을 확대하고 있었습니다.

definition: producing a great deal of profit; very profitable
contextSentence: The tea trade was so lucrative that the world's fastest sailboat, the Clipper Ship, was born.
contextSentenceKo: 차 무역은 워낙 수익성이 좋아서 세계에서 가장 빠른 범선인 클리퍼선이 탄생하게 되었습니다.

definition: a highly addictive narcotic drug obtained from the juice of the opium poppy
contextSentence: They suggested trading tea for another substance, opium.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 차를 다른 물질, 즉 아편과 교환할 것을 제안했습니다.

definition: physically and mentally dependent on a particular substance or activity
contextSentence: This triggered a public health problem within China, as people became addicted to the drug.
contextSentenceKo: 이것은 중국 내에서 공중 보건 문제를 촉발시켰고, 사람들은 마약에 중독되어 갔습니다.

definition: gave up power, territory, or rights, especially by treaty
etymology: Latin 'cedere' meaning 'to go, yield, give way'
contextSentence: The defeated Qing Dynasty ceded the port of Hong Kong to the British.
contextSentenceKo: 패배한 청나라는 홍콩 항구를 영국에 할양했습니다.

definition: ordered or authorized the production of something; gave an official task
contextSentence: They commissioned botanist Robert Fortune to steal tea from China in a covert operation.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 식물학자 로버트 포춘에게 비밀 작전으로 중국에서 차를 훔쳐오도록 의뢰했습니다.

definition: full of danger or risk; hazardous
contextSentence: He disguised himself and took a perilous journey through China's mountainous tea regions.
contextSentenceKo: 그는 변장을 하고 중국의 산악 차 재배 지역을 통과하는 위험한 여정을 떠났습니다.

definition: a raw material or primary agricultural product that can be bought and sold
contextSentence: Helping drive tea's rapid growth as an everyday commodity.
contextSentenceKo: 차가 일상적인 상품으로 빠르게 성장하는 데 기여했습니다.
